name: EGRET
summary: High-energy gamma-ray instrument on CGRO. Its diffuse-sky data were used for dark-matter annihilation searches and historical discussion of a GeV excess.
detection_principle: Gamma rays convert to electron–positron pairs in spark chambers. A calorimeter measures energy, and plastic-scintillator anticoincidence rejects charged particles.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: The host CGRO mission ended on June 4, 2000.

collaboration.name: EGRET collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

results.summary: External reanalyses proposed dark-matter interpretations. These historical claims are recorded without treating them as confirmed discoveries.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
